The File menu offers the same actions.
hilfe.einleitung: The application follows a sequence that builds on itself: the earlier areas should exist first. It makes sense to start at the beginning, not with the invoice.
hilfe.vorgaben: Set beforehand, changeable at any time: Settings holds the application-wide defaults, among them the interface language and the folder for the generated files. It is not a stage of the sequence; sensible defaults are in place.
hilfe.stufe_firma_text: Enter the company data and create it as a company file. Result: an active company as the basis; without it, the other areas cannot be used.
hilfe.stufe_artikel_text: Enter the products and services to be charged in invoices later. Result: an item master from which the lines of orders and invoices are chosen.
hilfe.stufe_kunden_text: Enter the customers. Result: customers to which orders are assigned.
hilfe.stufe_bestellung_titel: Create an order for the customer
hilfe.stufe_bestellung_text: Assign an order with its lines (from the items created) to a customer. Result: an order as the basis for invoices.
hilfe.stufe_rechnung_erfassen_titel: Enter an invoice for the order
hilfe.stufe_rechnung_erfassen_text: Enter the invoice data based on the order. Result: an entered invoice.
hilfe.stufe_rechnung_erstellen_text: Trigger the output. Result: the finished e-invoice as XRechnung (XML) and/or ZUGFeRD (PDF/A-3), compliant with EN 16931.
hilfe.uebersicht: Afterwards: the Invoice overview lists all invoices with their status and leads to the generated file. That is where a finished invoice can be found again later.
hilfe.empfehlung: The sequence described is a recommendation, not an order enforced by the application.
ueber.zweck: Creates legally compliant electronic invoices to the EU standard EN 16931, as XRechnung and ZUGFeRD.
